instruction: Box-joint wood joinery (5 fingers) Build two 200 x 200 x 20 mm wood boards joined at 90 degrees along a shared corner edge via 5 interlocking box-joint fingers (each finger 40 mm wide). All units are millimetres. Geometry (world frame, units = mm): 1. The shared corner edge runs along the X axis; both boards meet in the corner region Y in [0, 20], Z in [0, 20]. The shared edge is the X axis itself (Y = Z = 0). 2. Along the X axis, 5 fingers of width 40 mm alternate between the two boards: - finger i = 0 (X in [ 0, 40]) -> belongs to Board A (A's extension into the corner) - finger i = 1 (X in [ 40, 80]) -> belongs to Board B (B's extension into the corner) - finger i = 2 (X in [ 80, 120]) -> belongs to Board A - finger i = 3 (X in [120, 160]) -> belongs to Board B - finger i = 4 (X in [160, 200]) -> belongs to Board A So A contributes fingers at even i (0, 2, 4) and B contributes fingers at odd i (1, 3). A's fingers occupy the notches in B, and vice versa. 3. Board A is the horizontal board (200 x 200 x 20 mm, thickness along Z): - bulk: X in [0, 200], Y in [ 20, 200], Z in [0, 20] - fingers: X in [0, 40] U [80, 120] U [160, 200], Y in [0, 20], Z in [0, 20] Board A is a single solid manifold: the union of the bulk slab plus the three A-fingers. 4. Board B is the vertical board (200 x 200 x 20 mm, thickness along Y): - bulk: X in [0, 200], Y in [0, 20], Z in [ 20, 220] - fingers: X in [40, 80] U [120, 160], Y in [0, 20], Z in [0, 20] Board B is a single solid manifold: the union of the bulk slab plus the two B-fingers. Deliverables: - Export to `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\output.dae` at the output root. - The DAE must contain exactly 2 distinct ComponentDefinitions (BoardA and BoardB), each a separate geometry in `<library_geometries>`. - Each board must be a watertight solid manifold (no open seams in the corner, no cracks). - A's fingers and B's fingers must not intersect (they interlock; their AABBs are disjoint along X). Requirements: 1. `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\output.dae` parses as valid COLLADA. 2. There are exactly 2 distinct geometry definitions referenced in the scene (Board A and Board B). 3. The overall world-space axis-aligned bounding box is 200 mm (X) x 200 mm (Y) x 220 mm (Z) within 1 mm on each axis. 4. In the corner region (Y < 20 mm, Z < 20 mm) there are exactly 5 distinct finger X-spans, each ~40 mm wide, and: - 3 of the fingers belong to one board (A's extensions at X in [0,40], [80,120], [160,200]) and - 2 of the fingers belong to the other board (B's extensions at X in [40,80], [120,160]). 5. No finger of Board A overlaps with any finger of Board B (their axis-aligned bounding boxes in the corner region must be disjoint, with strictly non-overlapping X intervals). [Software] Launch SketchUp with `C:\SketchUp 2026 26.0.429 x64 En Portable\SketchUp.exe` (adjust if your install differs).
